title: Agentflow bug recurrence ledger frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a class ledger under docs/issues/recurrence/. One file per failure class that recurred or was consolidated; plain single-occurrence bugs do not get a ledger. The occurrence list holds bug_ids only — versions live on the referenced records so there is a single source of truth.

status.description: unconsolidated = not yet absorbed into Agentflow (rule clause, eval case, or tool check); consolidated = absorbed, consolidated_in names the version.

consolidated_in.description: Agentflow version whose upgrade absorbed this class.

first_record.description: bug_id of the record where the class first appeared.

occurrences.description: bug_ids belonging to this class, in chronological order.
